title: Where APP01's SQL maintenance lives and how to read it
symptom: Someone asks whether KOR-APP01\SQLEXPRESS is backed up, integrity-checked and index-maintained; the app login (opportunities_app) cannot read Agent jobs or master.dbo.CommandLog.
cause: Maintenance is Ola Hallengren's solution in SQL Agent: DatabaseBackup FULL nightly 01:33 (system) / 01:47 (user) to \\Kor-fs01\Library\ADMIN\SQL SERVER\BACKUPS; DatabaseIntegrityCheck weekly Sun 02:17/02:33; IndexOptimize weekly Sat 03:21; CommandLog/history cleanup nightly 04:11.
check: As sysadmin, read msdb.dbo.sysjobs/sysjobhistory (step 0) and master.dbo.CommandLog for 30 days. 27 Oct: FULL 30/30, CHECKDB 4/4 (21 DBs), IndexOptimize 4/4, 0 CommandLog errors. Proof: board row 30.
fix: Nothing to fix in the jobs themselves; gaps were retention and compression (separate cards).
plain: Remembers where APP01's SQL backups and checks run and how to confirm they are healthy.

title: SQL backups were uncompressed: turn on the server's backup compression default
symptom: Nightly SQL backups to FS01 are full size (KorEmailIndex 7.9 GB a night) and the FS01 backup folder grows fast.
cause: Server option 'backup compression default' was 0 and the Ola jobs pass no @Compress.
check: SELECT value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'backup compression default' (1 = on).
fix: EXEC sp_configure 'backup compression default', 1; RECONFIGURE; (dynamic, no restart; covers every job and copy-only backup; rollback = 0). Done 27 Oct 13:55, read back 1. Board row 33.
plain: Remembers that SQL backups are compressed by a server setting, and how to check or undo it.

title: SQL backups never pruned: 1.7 TB on FS01 - Ola @CleanupTime was NULL
symptom: \\Kor-fs01\Library\ADMIN\SQL SERVER\BACKUPS\Kor-APP01$SQLEXPRESS held 1,911 files / 1.7 TB covering 112 days (27 Oct); Veeam then backs all of it up again with FS01.
cause: @CleanupTime = NULL on the DatabaseBackup FULL jobs: Ola deletes nothing.
check: msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps command of 'DatabaseBackup - USER_DATABASES - FULL' and '- SYSTEM_DATABASES - FULL'; the FS01 folder's oldest file date.
fix: Ian approved 14:0x 27 Oct: @CleanupTime = 336 (14 days) on both FULL jobs via sp_update_jobstep, only that token changed, read back. Deletions happen after each successful FULL backup (first: 28 Oct 01:33/01:47). Deleted backups are recoverable only from Veeam's FS01 restore points. Board row 34.
plain: Remembers why old SQL backups piled up and that they are now kept 14 days.

title: APP01 C: low: move local .bak files to D:\SqlBackupArchive, hash-verified
symptom: KOR-APP01 C: had 27 GB free of 198; C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server\MSSQL16.SQLEXPRESS\MSSQL\Backup held ~27 GB of .bak (JoeBrain daily, pre-migration copy-only backups).
cause: Pre-migration copy-only backups and JoeBrain's own 03:30 backup write to the default Backup folder on C: and nothing prunes them.
check: Get-ChildItem that folder by size and date; free space on C:.
fix: Move (never delete) to APP01 D:\SqlBackupArchive: copy, SHA-256 both sides, remove the C: original only on a match. 27 Oct actions 11398 (8 files) + 11399 (31 files): C: 27.06 -> 50.21 GB. JoeBrain's 03:30 job still writes to C: daily and will pile up again. Rows 31, 35.
plain: Remembers how APP01's C: was freed safely and that JoeBrain's backup keeps filling it.

title: APP01 and FS01 could not open each other's admin shares (SYSTEM)
symptom: A NetworkOps run as SYSTEM on APP01 gets 'Access is denied' on \\KOR-FS01\E$, and on FS01 on \\KOR-APP01\C$ (actions 11395/11396), so a server-to-server file move fails.
cause: SYSTEM uses the machine account over the network (KOR\KOR-APP01$, KOR\KOR-FS01$), which was not in the other server's local Administrators.
check: From each server via netops run: Test-Path on the other's admin share.
fix: Ian approved 27 Oct: Add-LocalGroupMember Administrators -Member 'KOR\KOR-APP01$' on FS01 (11400) and 'KOR\KOR-FS01$' on APP01 (11401). Works at once, no reboot (11402/11403). Effect: SYSTEM on either is admin on the other. Row 39.
plain: Remembers why APP01 and FS01 could not copy to each other and how it was opened.

title: BK01 (workgroup) agent update when APP01 cannot reach its service manager
symptom: netops fix install-agent on KOR-BK01 fails: 'OpenSCManager on KOR-BK01 failed' (action 11397); agent stuck on an old version (1.2.3 has no self-update).
cause: BK01 is a workgroup machine: APP01's network install (SMB/445 + SCM as the machine account) cannot authenticate there.
check: netops run on KOR-BK01 reading the agent exe's ProductVersion.
fix: Re-enrol ON BK01: netops add-pc --hosts KOR-BK01 issues a one-time code + command; run that command on BK01 through its current agent but as a ONE-OFF SYSTEM scheduled task (--enrol stops the agent, which would kill a child of the agent's job). 27 Oct: 11404 -> 11410 agent 1.2.4 running, enrol log exit=0, remote control reinstalled. Row 32.
plain: Remembers how to update the agent on the Veeam server, which the normal install cannot reach.

title: netops calls hang silently when the NetworkOps MFA sign-in lapses
symptom: Every netops call (run, last-check) from a session hangs with no output and no exit; /api/ping on APP01 still answers. 27 Oct ~02:06-04:10 a 302N dialog watch went blind for 2 h.
cause: The NetworkOps API's Conditional Access requires MFA every 12 h. The silent token fails and the old CLI opened an interactive browser sign-in on an empty screen and waited forever.
check: netops token with stdin redirected: exit 4 'SIGN-IN NEEDED' = lapsed.
fix: CLI 4998d6db: no prompt when stdin is redirected (KOR_NETOPS_INTERACTIVE=1 overrides), 3-minute cap otherwise; exit 4 = sign-in needed, exit 5 = no answer. Ian (or the app) signs in: run netops token in a real terminal on KOR-1001. Treat exit 4 as BLIND in any watch.
plain: Remembers why NetworkOps commands stop working overnight and what to do.

title: Runs on KOR-302N / KOR-1001 need --approved-by
symptom: netops run / copy / MCP networkops_run on KOR-302N or KOR-1001 is refused: 'is protected: name who approved this one action'; run --direct exits 6.
cause: Ian's order (23 Oct, 'Dont touch 1001 or 302n'): service 0.67.0 (7b5d7d5a) refuses those machines on every road without an approval; the refusal is itself an audited row.
check: The refusal text, or action status 'Refused' (e.g. 11369).
fix: Add --approved-by "<who>, <HH:mm>" exactly as Ian or operations-ee gave it for that one action (MCP: approvedBy). It is written into the audited purpose. Proven 11369 refused / 11370 approved.
plain: Remembers that the Revit box and Ian's PC need a named approval for every run.

title: An old Debug build of netops has no 302N guard or fail-fast: use C:\KOR-Operations\cli
symptom: A script calls ...\Kor.Operations.NetworkOps.Cli\bin\Debug\...\netops.exe: --approved-by gives exit 2 'Unknown argument', without it APP01 refuses 302N, and a lapsed sign-in hangs it.
cause: bin\Debug was a 16 Oct build (27 Oct, Standard Details' run 2 near miss), older than fail-fast and the guard.
check: Search the build's netops.dll for the UTF-16 text '--approved-by'; compare file dates.
fix: Call only the installed CLI, C:\KOR-Operations\cli\netops.exe (install-netops.ps1 swaps it under running bridges and hash-verifies every file).
plain: Remembers to use the installed NetworkOps CLI, never a stale build.

title: SureBackup 'Domain Controller restore from a crash-consistent backup' with application-aware processing ON
symptom: SureBackup - Kor-Core fails nightly: Kor-DC01 Failed, FS01/APP01/RDS01 NotRunning; log: 'unable to perform Domain Controller restore from a crash-consistent backup ... (System.TimeoutException)' in WaitForStableIp.
cause: The message is Veeam's stock hint: Kor-VMs-New IS application-aware for DC01 (VSS on, guest creds, 'Preparing guest for hot backup' Succeeded). DC01 never reached a stable IP in the lab; every restore point since the 23 Oct no-restart updates fails (restart pending on DC01), 19-23 Oct passed. The app group stops when DC01 fails, so the others are never tested.
check: BK01: C:\ProgramData\Veeam\Backup\SureBackup_-_Kor-Core\Job.SureBackup_-_Kor-Core.log; Get-VBRSureBackupTaskSession; the backup job's DC01 task log (actions 11328/11329).
fix: Restart DC01 (and the other servers with pending restarts), let the next backup take a clean point, then the next SureBackup run should pass. Fallback: raise DC01's maximum boot time in the app group.
plain: Remembers the real reason the nightly restore test failed and how it is fixed.

title: git push to \\KOR-FS01\E$\IT\git fails: could not write multi-pack-index: Permission denied
symptom: Every push to E:\IT\git\KOR.Drafter.git ends 'remote: fatal: could not write multi-pack-index: Permission denied' and 'failed to perform geometric repack'.
cause: Not the ACL: the pusher (kor\ilalonde, Domain Admins) has FullControl (action 11334). Most likely the old index was held open by a LOCAL process on FS01 (Get-SmbOpenFile only shows SMB opens). An owner of BUILTIN\Administrators proves nothing: it is the default owner of any admin-created file.
check: Get-SmbOpenFile on FS01 for the repo; the account's real token (S4U WindowsIdentity) before blaming an ACL.
fix: Rename objects\pack\multi-pack-index aside as SYSTEM (e.g. .held-<date>); the next push writes a fresh one (27 Oct action 11332; push then clean). Run git maintenance on FS01 as the pushing user, never as SYSTEM.
plain: Remembers how a stuck git backup on FS01 was cleared.

title: The bridge cannot close Revit's ACTIVE document: restart that Revit year
symptom: A bridge request to close the active document in Revit on KOR-302N does nothing or errors; the next job finds the document still open.
cause: Revit's API cannot close the active document from inside the add-in.
check: The bridge ping / Revit journal shows the document still open.
fix: Restart that Revit year with KOR.Drafter install\Switch-Revit.ps1 through netops run with --approved-by: -StopYear N -StartYear N (StartYear is mandatory). 27 Oct actions 11386, 11387. (operations-ee)
plain: Remembers how to clear a document the Revit bridge cannot close.

title: Revit's journal tells an answered dialog from a stuck one
symptom: A Revit run on KOR-302N seems stopped; unclear whether a dialog is waiting.
cause: Revit dialogs block the bridge until answered.
check: In the Revit journal: TaskDialogResult followed by Jrn.Activate and then idle0_doc means answered and Revit idle; a TaskDialog with none of those after it means stuck at the dialog. (operations-ee)
fix: Stuck: answer or dismiss the dialog (or restart that Revit year with Switch-Revit); answered: look elsewhere.
plain: Remembers how to tell from Revit's log whether it is waiting at a dialog.

title: A bridge watch hung 2 h on a lapsed netops sign-in
symptom: The overnight 302N dialog watch stopped reporting for about 2 hours (27 Oct).
cause: Its netops calls waited on an MFA prompt (see the sign-in card) with no timeout of their own.
check: The watch's own log has gaps; netops exits 4 now.
fix: Each watch call has a 150 s timeout, and exit 4 is reported as BLIND (alarm), never as quiet. (operations-ee)
plain: Remembers that a watch must time out and alarm when NetworkOps sign-in lapses.

title: KOR-302N runs ONE Revit at a time
symptom: Two Revit years open together on KOR-302N confuse the bridge: requests answered by the wrong year or lost.
cause: All Revit years on 302N share one bridge folder, C:\KOR.Drafter\bridge.
fix: Switch years with Switch-Revit (it stops one before starting the other); never start a second year alongside. (operations-ee)
plain: Remembers that the Revit box runs only one Revit version at a time.
